feature: Bohemia browser writing room with direct GitHub publishing
browser_checks: Existing published articles load with body, metadata and fixed URL
New article has empty fields and demo=false
All 14 columns are available in the selector
Text edits automatically save and survive page reload
Selected cover decodes, saves to IndexedDB and survives reload
Markdown toolbar inserts formatting and preview renders it
Preview strips script tags and javascript links; no script executes
Repository draft option changes the publish action label
Empty article is rejected before authentication or repository writes
Invalid GitHub credential returns a readable 401 message and clears the credential field
Markdown export produces a real UTF-8 file
Article edit link opens the correct article in the writing room
1440px desktop, 768px tablet, 390px and 320px mobile have no horizontal overflow
Mobile switches between editing and reading preview
Production preview has no development runtime and no new browser console errors
Homepage Side A/B and Now Playing remain synchronized
Article code blocks, copy controls and table of contents remain available
credentials: Kept only in the page client instance; not written to IndexedDB, localStorage, sessionStorage, URLs or repository source
storage: IndexedDB drafts are local to the browser; GitHub commits sync across devices after connection
